portrait.guidance: The 800×800 portrait is a clean cutout against essentially flat orange, matching the banner's saturated hue. Hair begins about y=57 (7% top margin); chin is around y=546 (68%); shoulders extend beyond both bottom corners. The head spans roughly x=224–579 (44% of the frame), while the chest fills the bottom third. The face is nearly frontal with a slight angle, direct eye contact, and a broad natural smile. Black crew-neck clothing reduces competition with the face. Light is broad and soft, with gentle shadow on the image-right side, visible skin texture, and no dramatic rim light. The eyes sit around y=285 (36%). This crop is close enough for recognition at avatar size while the hair remains inside the circular crop. The orange edge treatment around hair is relatively crisp; avoid reproducing any overly hard mask or halo.
